summary.headline: Big Weekend for Gracyn, Tough Stretch for Others
body: Gracyn had a standout weekend for Gardner-Webb, racking up 24 kills as the Runnin' Bulldogs split their weekend, beating New Orleans and Mercer on Saturday after a Friday loss to West Georgia. Her hitting was a bright spot in a busy stretch of matches.

Anna's Morehead State Eagles had a rough two days at home, falling 3-0 to both Cincinnati and Michigan State. Anna still made her mark defensively with 2 blocks against Michigan State, showing steady effort even as the team searches for its footing before conference play.

Layla's Winona State team went 1-1 over the weekend, beating Sioux Falls but falling to Southwest Minnesota State. Layla hasn't seen match action yet this season, though she remains on the active roster as the Warriors keep working through a tough non-conference slate.

spotlight.name: Gracyn Sanders
spotlight.note: Her 24 kills powered Gardner-Webb to two wins in a busy three-match weekend.

players.name: Anna Schiltz
players.blurb: Anna is getting steady court time as a backup middle blocker for the Eagles. The team is 4-4 overall after starting strong with three wins at the Mercyhurst Invitational, but has since dropped two home games to Michigan State and Cincinnati. Anna contributed 2 blocks in her 2 sets of play against Michigan State last Saturday.

players.name: Elizabeth King
players.blurb: Elizabeth is a freshman outside hitter who has played in 8 matches this fall while primarily developing her game off the bench. She recorded 20 kills and 8 block assists in limited sets played. The Flames took two straight wins to close out their home invitational, improving momentum heading into conference play next week.
